summaries.Romania: Romania faces political gridlock as President Nicușor Dan designates Luca Niculescu as premier amid fragmented parliament, while the Constitutional Court continues resolving governance conflicts. Economic pressures mount with currency depreciation, energy price warnings, and ongoing infrastructure challenges.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with stem cell treatments gaining momentum, hospital longevity programs expanding, and FDA preparing 2027 AI guidance while grappling with price transparency and AI's role in care delivery. Cybersecurity threats to healthcare systems intensify as AI-driven attacks pose unprecedented risks.
summaries.Tech: Apple expands smart home ecosystem with LG partnership while facing patent damages, AI breakthroughs reshape mathematics and content moderation, and major streaming consolidation occurs as Prime Video gains Emmy broadcasts. October product announcements signal Apple's busy month with iPhone Duo launch and rumored MacBook touchscreen debut.

items.title: Apple must pay Masimo an extra $184M for Apple Watch patent infringement
items.snippet:
It’s almost a year since Apple was found to have infringed a Masimo patent for low-power pulse oximeter features used in the Apple Watch.
